title: Yeh Zindagi Ka Safar
desc: A young woman's perfect world crumbles after she reads an article written by an ambitious editor. Determined to unearth the truth about her past, she sets out on a painful journey, with him in tow.

title: Holiday
desc: While holidaying in Goa with her family, a shy Muskaan falls for Dino, a dancer at the resort. Problems ensue when her father objects to their relationship as he believes Dino has impregnated a woman.

title: Judaa Hoke Bhi
desc: A married couple struggling with an unimaginable loss are further torn apart when they are lured under false pretences to Uttarakhand separately

title: Faltu
desc: Four Desperate Friends, Who Secure Poor Grades In Their Examinations, Concoct A Fake University When They Fail To Secure College Admissions And Face Dismal Futures.

title: Fryday
desc: Rajiv, A Failed Salesman Is Given A Last Chance To Save His Job. However, He Becomes Entangled In A Complicated Situation Involving A Quirky Couple In His Quest To Sell His Product.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Mahi
desc: A former cricketer turned coach, played by Rajkummar Rao, helps his wife, Janhvi Kapoor, achieve stardom in the sport, but struggles to cope with her rising fame and his own fading glory.

title: Sajini Shinde Ka Viral Video
desc: When a school teacher goes missing after a risque video of her is posted on the internet, a police officer is tasked with uncovering the truth behind her disappearance.

title: I Want To Talk
desc: Arjun loves to talk and lives the 'American Dream'-until he learns he has only 100 days left! Now, he wants just 2 things: to spend his remaining time with his 7-year-old estranged daughter.

title: Raangi
desc: An online reporter discovers her niece's fake Facebook account, meets Libyan boy Aalim, while the FBI plans to capture him using Thaiyal Nayagi and the niece as bait.

title: Joggers Park
desc: Jenny, a confident single woman, lives life on her own terms. Everything changes when a retired judge unexpectedly falls for her and enters her world.

title: Phobia
desc: Mehak becomes a victim of agoraphobia. Later, she comes across something that makes her believe that she is being haunted by a spirit.

title: Kasoor
desc: When Shekhar is accused of killing his wife, he hires Simran, a lawyer with a spotless record. She believes he is innocent and starts developing feelings for him, unaware of his true intentions.
